title: financial-RAG-pipeline: code and data for Hybrid Document-Routed Retrieval (HDRR)
description: Code and data reproducing the article "Sustainable Hybrid Document-Routed Retrieval for Financial RAG: Resolving the Robustness-Precision Trade-off" (Intelligent Systems with Applications 32, 200720, 2026). Contains the full retrieval pipeline, every system compared in the article (CBR, SFR, HDRR, CBR+Meta, CBR+LLM-Ctx, Agentic), the five fixed 300-query FinDER splits, and the raw per-query outputs and benchmark scores behind each reported table. The 10-K corpus is public on SEC EDGAR and is not redistributed.
